description_en: Queries the list of exported files
description_zh: 查询导出后的文件列表
kebab_example: aliyun agency list-export-tasks --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --biz-language en --scene-code intlExportUsageDeductHistory --id 12343 --api-version 2022-12-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListExportTasks

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页，当前页码，从 1 开始
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页每页记录数，最大值100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The language parameter. Valid values:
- en: English.
- zh: Chinese.
- ja: Japanese
parameters.help_zh:
多语言参数
en：英文
zh：中文
ja：日文
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en:
The export scenario code. Valid values:
- intlCustomerQuotaRecord: customer management, quota transaction export.
- intlExportUsageDeductHistory: customer management, deduction details export
parameters.help_zh:
导出场景code
intlCustomerQuotaRecord：客户管理，quota流水导出
intlExportUsageDeductHistory：客户管理，冲减明细导出
parameters.name: scene_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the export task
parameters.name: id
